title: •Beru Stew

game_text: USED: Activate 1 Force (2 if a Lars on table). OR During battle at a farm, add the destiny number of your device on this farm to your total power. LOST: During battle at a farm, after battle destinies are drawn, place a ‘crop’ out of play to make attrition against you = 0.
lore: Moisture farmers grow enough food to sustain Tatooine’s population. Beru Lars has devised many dishes using herbs and roots naturally found in Tatooine’s desert.
